description: This file defines the interface for plugins within the WPEFramework, including plugin lifecycle management, communication, security, and notification mechanisms. It declares the IPlugin interface and related nested interfaces for plugin notifications, web interactions, WebSocket, text socket, channel, security, and authentication.

classes.name: IPlugin
classes.description: Main plugin interface providing lifecycle methods and notification mechanisms.

classes.name: IPluginExtended
classes.description: Extended plugin interface supporting communication channels.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin
classes.description: Interface for composite plugins managing plugin notifications.

classes.name: IWeb
classes.description: Interface for web request handling and processing.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for raw data channel communication.

classes.name: ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security validation and token management.

classes.name: IAuthenticate
classes.description: Interface for token creation and security officer access.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Called when a plugin is loaded to initialize it with the provided shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Called when a plugin is unloaded to perform cleanup.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a communication channel to the plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a communication channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification with the plugin.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification from the plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests or WebSocket messages.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a web request and returns a response.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles raw data inbound on a channel.

methods.name: Outbound
methods.description: Sends raw data outbound on a channel.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a WebSocket upgrade or request is allowed.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Returns the security officer interface for a given token.
